description: A standard Fabric-ecosystem scan must return a single valid JSON object carrying at least 3 signals and echoing the requested horizon.

input.topic: Microsoft Fabric adoption in Southern African enterprises

expected_output.shape: single JSON object with keys topic, horizon_days, summary, signals

rubric.condition: The entire output parses as a single JSON object with json.loads and no surrounding prose or markdown fences.
The signals array contains at least 3 items.
The signals array contains at most 8 items.
The summary field contains the literal digits of the requested horizon_days value, which is 30.

notes: Anchored to prompt.md hard rules 1 and 6.
